name: Portrait-led interview
prompt: High-fidelity desktop About-page composition probe for Alex Metelli’s editorial engineering portfolio. A compact site header leads into a large asymmetrical opening grid: a tall real portrait plate on the left, and on the right an About / Field Interview label, the headline ‘Engineering work built around correctness, clarity, and delivery.’, a short factual lead, and three rule-separated Q&A entries: What I work on, How I work, and What I’m looking for. A lower evidence register carries capabilities and principles. Warm paper, deep navy ink, Georgia-like serif display, restrained evidence blue, sans body, square regions, hairline cool-gray rules, no gradients, shadows, cards, dashboard chrome, or invented claims.
